payload.summary: One abrupt move triggers a chain reaction before anyone agrees on what should replace the old plan.
payload.body: One abrupt move triggers a chain reaction before anyone agrees on what should replace the old plan. Mars square Uranus can make disruption outrun coordination, so a walkout, shutdown, technical change, or public confrontation creates new problems faster than the original one can be solved. The impulse to break the pattern may be right. The timing can still be reckless. Contain the fallout, identify what absolutely has to change, and test the replacement on the smallest scale that still produces useful information.
